title: fix(rest,hono,runtime): a refusal carrying a userMessage says it varies by Accept-Language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoQefGB8TKeyL54c2KqvjDG4)_

Fixes #37828

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户看不到变化：记录不存在时返回的提示本来就按请求语言给出，现在响应头也写明它随请求语言变化，缓存就不会把一种语言的提示交给说另一种语言的人。
- 属于界面多语言这条线，替用多种语言访问同一部署的用户解决提示语言串掉的问题。
- 只多一个响应头，状态码、错误码和正文都不变；有问题可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `packages/types/src/localized-answer-vary.ts` (new, exported from the index): `LOCALIZED_ANSWER_VARY` (`'Accept-Language'`) and `answerVariesByLanguage(body)`, true when a refusal body carries a non-empty `userMessage`, either flat (`/data`'s `{ error, code, userMessage }`) or nested (`{ success: false, error: { userMessage } }`). Per the seat's ruling on the claim, the rule ignores the status: no table of cacheable statuses.
- Three exits ask it about the body they are about to send, and add the token in their host's append form, so a `Vary` another layer writes keeps its tokens:
  - `packages/rest/src/crud-routes.ts`: `sendReadRefusal`, used by the catches of `GET /data/:object/:id` (the exit production serves, measured below) and `GET /data/:object`. It writes `res.header('Vary', ['Accept-Language'])`, the contract's multi-value form, which the Hono server adapter appends.
  - `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts`: `thrownJson`'s declared arm, so both `createHonoApp` catch arms (the dispatch catch-all and the auth mount), with `c.header(..., { append: true })`.
  - `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`: `errorResponseBase`, for a throw that leaves `dispatch()`.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/types`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/hono`, `@objectstack/runtime` patch.

## Tests
Each pin goes into the existing harness file for its exit, as a top-level `describe`:
- `packages/rest/src/data-record-read-malformed-query-door.test.ts`: the real route and mapper, with `getData` throwing the real `recordNotFoundError` for an `en` / `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` caller. Each case asserts 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, the `userMessage` in that language, and exactly one `Vary` write of `['Accept-Language']` in the multi-value form. Control: a 404 without a `userMessage` writes no `Vary`.
- `packages/adapters/hono/src/hono-thrown-message-disclosure.test.ts`: the catch-all arm and the auth-mount arm, each asserting 404 plus `Vary: Accept-Language`. With CORS on, `Origin` and `Accept-Language` are both present. Control: no `userMessage`, no `Vary`.
- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.declared-user-message.test.ts`: the real throw-transparent route with `recordNotFoundError` for a zh-CN caller, and a marked 400 to cover the status-agnostic rule. Control: no `userMessage`, no `Vary`. The harness `makeRes` now records headers. The file gains a module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'`, which `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited file whose reach loads it dynamically.

<details><summary>Readings (base origin/main 815e882b)</summary>

- Before the fix, on a fresh showcase boot (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, admin session): `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_inquiry/no_such_id_37828` returned `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` with `userMessage` in en / zh-CN / ja-JP, and `vary: Origin, Accept-Encoding`. The body was the flat `mapDataError` shape, so RestServer served it, an exit the card had not named.
- After the fix, same boot recipe on the branch: the same request returns `vary: Accept-Language, Origin, Accept-Encoding` for en and zh-CN. `GET /api/v1/data/no_such_object_37828/x` (404 `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`, no `userMessage`) still returns `vary: Origin, Accept-Encoding`.
- Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed fix. Each run deleted one exit's header line, then restored it, and every restore was checked as `blob == HEAD` with an empty `git diff HEAD`. All three suites import that exit from source.
  - rest: `Tests  4 failed | 13 passed (17)`. The four positive pins failed and the control passed.
  - hono: `Tests  3 failed | 8 passed (11)`. The three positive pins failed and the control passed.
  - runtime: `Tests  2 failed | 21 passed (23)`. The two positive pins failed and the control passed.
- Package suites (`pnpm --filter <pkg> test`, each under the verify lock, exit 0):
  - types: 42 files, 963 tests.
  - hono: 14 files, 262 tests.
  - rest: 432 files, 8978 passed and 351 skipped.
  - runtime: 655 files, 12316 passed and 25 skipped.
- `typecheck` exit 0 on all four packages. For rest and runtime that includes `check:test-typecheck`; for hono it includes `tsconfig.test.json`.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` exit 0 on the eight touched `.ts` files.
- Derived local gate set at `214577c9`: `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles 72 derived, 72 run, every one recorded `exit 0`, 0 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. On the first pass `check:test-source-alias` was red on the edited runtime suite, and the module-top import above fixes it. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its fixture commit fetched into the shallow clone.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- Scope next to the claim: the list route `GET /data/:object` uses the same `sendReadRefusal`. It is the other read catch in the same file, it has the same shape, and the same rule applies. The write routes in that file are unchanged, because a response to PATCH, POST or DELETE is not stored by a cache.
- Deviation from the claim's wording: the claim listed "a dedupe-append `Vary` helper". The exits add the token in their host's append form instead. `IHttpResponse` has no header read, so a dedupe helper would have nothing to read at two of the three exits, and appending already keeps everyone else's tokens.
- Not covered, for the seat to judge: answers that a dispatcher domain catches itself and renders through `HttpDispatcher.errorFromThrown`, which can also carry a `userMessage`. Those leave as `result.response` without this header. They are not in the claimed surface. Carrier: the seat.
- The dispatcher plugin does not mount `/data` (its docblock: domains not covered by `@objectstack/rest`), so its pin drives the file's throw-transparent analytics route. The rule belongs to the exit, not to any one route.

## Verification
Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/rest/src/crud-routes.ts`: `sendReadRefusal` and its two call sites (the production exit).
2. `packages/types/src/localized-answer-vary.ts`: the predicate, both envelopes.
3. `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`: the end of `errorResponseBase`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/data-record-read-malformed-query-door.test.ts` shows 17 passing. Delete the `res.header('Vary', …)` line in `sendReadRefusal` and the same command shows 4 failing.
